skill.summary: Access Whoop wearable health data (sleep, recovery, strain, HRV, workouts) and generate interactive charts. Use when the user asks about sleep quality, recovery scores, strain levels, HRV trends, workout data, or wants health visualizations/graphs from their Whoop band.

latestVersion.changelog: Upgraded charts to ApexCharts: zoom/pan, gradient fills, recovery zone annotations, HRV 7-day moving average, short date labels, smooth animations. Fixed dashboard rendering issues.
